heading:
Slow mornings.
Long, easy evenings.
body: Everything at Meridian is planned so you don't have to. Three things guests love most, ready from the moment you arrive.

features.title: Wake
features.body: Breakfast on the terrace until noon, with bread baked in our own oven.

features.title: Swim
features.body: Heated pools, a quiet cove and boats to the islands every afternoon.

features.title: Unwind
features.body: Treatments in the garden spa, then dinner under the olive trees.
